laws.rule: From 1 April 2026, top-tier parks (including Etosha, Namib-Naukluft, Dorob, Skeleton Coast, Waterberg, Cape Cross): nationals of non-SADC foreign countries aged 16 and over pay N$280 a day (N$140 park entrance plus N$140 conservation fee); ages 9 to 15 N$180; 8 and under free. Vehicles with 10 seats or less N$60. No RBA rate for NAD.
